title: Minswap Cardano DeFi Onboarding: Marketing Program

ms.promise:
・The contracting of content creators on 𝕏 from other blockchain ecosystems to create content related to Minswap, Cardano and the Minswap DeFi Onboarding Zealy campaign.
・A series of posts from non-Cardano native 𝕏 creator accounts.
ms.criteria:
・The content creators from the other ecosystems are creating informational and educational content, directing their audiences to engage with Minswap and its Onboarding Program
・A large number of views on the 𝕏 posts made by the non-Cardano native creator accounts
ms.report: The summary report for this milestone's activity and completion is linked here.

ms.promise:
A wide array of Zealy Campaign Tasks published to Zealy
These tasks will direct users to complete tasks under the following categories:
・Engagement boosting for Minswap's 𝕏 posts and Minswap Ambassadors's 𝕏 posts - these will be the "Daily Quests (designed to keep the community engaged)"
・Engage on-chain with Minswap to generate transaction fees for the Cardano blockchain and get users to engage with Cardano's DeFi - these will be the "Onboarding Quests"
・Direct users towards educational material to help them understand Cardano and Cardano's DeFi better - these will be a part of the "Kitty Quests"
・Content creation quests whereby the participants will be expected to create content covering the content they have learned from the educational material and other tasks - also a part of "Kitty Quests"
ms.criteria:
・Users have submitted proof of engagement with the relevant 𝕏 posts from Minswap and its ambassadors at the time (not related to this proposal)
・Users have submitted a transaction on-chain
・Users have visited the educational content about Cardano and Cardano's DeFi
ms.report:
・A comprehensive completion report has been created here.
・Link to Zealy community with tasks live at the time of writing: https://zealy.io/cw/minswap
